# Rosternado

> Flight roster sharing app for aviation crew. Import your roster from your airline in one tap, organize duties in a colour-coded timeline, track crew friends on a live map, and share your flight schedule with friends and family.

Rosternado is built by an airline pilot who got tired of cluttered, ad-heavy aviation apps. It brings simplicity, privacy, and clarity to crew scheduling without distraction: no weather forecasts, no METARs, no NOTAMs, no ads, and no tracking.

## Core Features

- **One-Tap Roster Import**: Open your airline's crew portal inside the app, log in, and tap Save. Rosternado parses your roster automatically.
- **Colour-Coded Duty Timeline**: Flights, standby, simulator/training, days off, annual leave, office duties, and transfers in a clean chronological list. Multi-leg flights are grouped into single cards so 3-sector days read as one duty.
- **Friend Radar**: See accepted crew friends on a live map with flight progress and estimated arrivals. Positions are approximate and updated periodically for friends and family.
- **Plan a Meetup**: Automatically finds overlapping free time windows where you and your crew friends are off at the same time in the same city or layover base.
- **Friend Alerts**: Optional per-friend notifications the moment a friend's new roster is uploaded.
- **Offline First**: All roster data is cached on-device for seamless access mid-flight or in layover hotels without signal.
- **Friends & Family Mode**: Non-crew members can follow a crew friend or family member's schedule for free to know when they are flying, landing, or home.

- [Supported Airlines](https://rosternado.com/airlines.html): Full breakdown of verified airline parsers, beta CAE portal airlines, and manual entry support.
- [Support & FAQ](https://rosternado.com/support.html): Frequently asked questions, roster upload troubleshooting, subscription management, and support contact.
- [Privacy Policy](https://rosternado.com/privacy.html): Comprehensive privacy terms detailing our no-tracking, no-ads, friend-only visibility policies.
- [Terms of Service](https://rosternado.com/terms.html): Terms and conditions governing the use of Rosternado.
- [Delete Account](https://rosternado.com/delete-account.html): Step-by-step account deletion instructions with permanent data purge.
